record: pi_A vs pi_B trajectory separability probe
purpose: Prerequisite for any trajectory-grounded latent objective. Gates the CONTENT of a future V3 spec; authorizes nothing.
meaning: On both poles, held-out trajectories of the two proven specialists are separable with the opponent held fixed. A trajectory-grounded latent objective has a real target to aim at.

thresholds_frozen_before_reading.rationale: 0.70 is the project's existing tau convention. The shuffle margin exists because n~190 with d=128 makes overfitting a live risk, so a real signal must beat its own shuffle.

confound_control.why: pi_A@PoleA vs pi_B@PoleB lets a classifier win by identifying the OPPONENT rather than the strategy. Both specialists are therefore compared on the SAME pole.

Pole A.comparison: pi_A vs pi_B, both on Pole A

Pole B.comparison: pi_A vs pi_B, both on Pole B

authorizes: nothing; a V3 spec requires a separate PI decision

AMENDMENT_1_METRIC_SCALE.authority: PI, 2026-08-31, immediately after the probe result
AMENDMENT_1_METRIC_SCALE.status: wording correction only; no number, split, threshold, or verdict changes
AMENDMENT_1_METRIC_SCALE.the_error: The result was initially summarised as '22% signal versus 96% signal', placing action-disagreement rate and balanced classification accuracy on a shared axis. They are different metrics on different scales and their ratio means nothing.
AMENDMENT_1_METRIC_SCALE.corrected_statement: Single-state teacher actions provide relatively sparse disagreement, while aggregate trajectories contain highly discriminative specialist identity on held-out seeds with the opponent controlled.
AMENDMENT_1_METRIC_SCALE.why_it_still_motivates_trajectory_superv: The argument does not need the two numbers to be commensurable. It needs only that specialist identity is recoverable from held-out trajectories at 0.95-0.97 balanced accuracy with the opponent fixed, which establishes a measurable long-horizon target that state-level supervision never addressed.
